speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Delirium Tremens (Severe Alcohol Withdrawal)

The previous suggestion of Tuberculosis was likely incorrect given the normal chest X-ray and his denial of drug use. His agitation and bizarre behavior are more consistent with a severe metabolic or toxicologic withdrawal state, specifically alcohol withdrawal, which I suspect occurred despite his claims. Have you noticed any history of heavy alcohol consumption, seizures, or tremors in your husband prior to this episode?
